about.title: Our Story & Atelier
about.subtitle: Artisanship, devotion, and the quiet poetry of thoughtful giving.

sections.heading: Born from Slow Living & Sincere Emotion
sections.body: Founded in 2024, ELARA & CO. began as a small dream table filled with dried hydrangeas, raw rose quartz, and spools of hand-torn chiffon ribbon. We felt modern gifting had become algorithmic, impersonal, and hurried. We set out to build an atelier where gifts feel deeply personal and memorable.

sections.heading: Handcrafted with Intention
sections.body: Every bracelet is hand-knotted by woman artisans, every dried botanical stem is individually preserved, and every gift hamper is assembled with personalized wax-sealed notes. We honor slow craftsmanship over mass production.

sections.heading: Our Sustainability Promise
sections.body: Our packaging is 100% biodegradable and recyclable. We use cruelty-free soy wax, recycled paper, and sustainable packaging materials to protect both your gift and our planet.

contact.title: Connect with Our Atelier
contact.subtitle: We're here to assist with custom hamper curation, corporate orders, and bespoke gift design.

sections.heading: Studio Concierge
sections.body: Have a bespoke custom gift request or need advice on choosing the perfect keepsake? Reach out to our dedicated gifting concierges.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ordering, delivery, customization, and care.

sections.heading: How long does delivery take across India?
sections.body: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days across metros and tier-1 cities. Express delivery arrives within 24 to 48 hours. Custom engraved gifts require 1 additional day of studio crafting time.

sections.heading: Can I include a personalized handwritten message?
sections.body: Yes! Every order includes a complimentary gold-foil card with your custom message hand-penned by our studio calligrapher. Simply enter your message during checkout.

sections.heading: Are the floral bouquets real flowers?
sections.body: Our bouquets are created using genuine botanicals preserved using eco-friendly natural glycerine, or hand-crocheted cotton yarn blossoms that never wither. They maintain their beauty for years without water.

sections.heading: What if a delicate item arrives damaged?
sections.body: We pack every order with triple-layer protective padding and luxury gift boxes. However, if transit damage occurs, simply message us on WhatsApp with photos within 48 hours for an instant complimentary replacement.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping.subtitle: Carefully packaged, insured, and swiftly delivered to your doorstep.

sections.heading: Complimentary Shipping Over ₹999
sections.body: All orders valued at ₹999 or above receive free standard tracked shipping throughout India. Orders below ₹999 have a flat nominal shipping fee of ₹79.

sections.heading: Dispatch Timeline
sections.body: Orders placed before 2:00 PM IST Monday through Saturday are dispatched the same evening from our Bengaluru studio. Tracking numbers are sent via SMS and email as soon as the courier scans your package.

returns.title: Return & Exchange Policy
returns.subtitle: Complete peace of mind with our 7-day hassle-free replacement promise.

sections.heading: 7-Day Replacement Guarantee
sections.body: Because our products include handcrafted jewelry and personalized keepsakes, we offer 7-day replacements for any manufacturing defects or transit damages. Simply send photos to concierge@elaraandco.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we respect, safeguard, and secure your personal information.

sections.heading: Data Protection
sections.body: ELARA & CO. respects your privacy. We never sell, rent, or distribute your email, telephone number, or delivery address to third parties.
